Load all reference lists

Source: R/cleaning_reference.R
load_all_reference_lists.Rd

Convenience wrapper that loads stop words, block patterns, and functional categories in one call. Returns a named list.

Usage

load_all_reference_lists(cache_dir = NULL)

Arguments

cache_dir

Directory for cache files (e.g., "data/reference_cache")

Value

List with keys: stop_words, block_patterns, functional_categories, strip_terms, corrections, isotope_lookup, unit_map, unit_synonyms, toxval_schema, media_map

Examples

cache_dir <- system.file("extdata", "reference_cache", package = "concert")
refs <- load_all_reference_lists(cache_dir)
